Method of Attack: Malicious audio file (FLAC or MP3) crafted to be indexed by Gstreamer as a SNES music file, exploiting vulnerabilities in Gstreamer libraries to execute code with user privileges
Malformed crash report file opened by Ubuntu users triggering code execution via Apport crash reporting tool
Attack Vector: Hosting and downloading malicious audio files that are automatically indexed by Gstreamer
Social engineering to convince users to open malformed crash report files
